seatedToss.guidance: Sidaon long wan tebol mo tekem taem blong tromoe wan sof bin beg i go long bigfala target. Kipim rekod long pepa, tugeta.
steps: Printem target mo sit blong tali, mo putum i flet long tebol namel long yufala.
Sidaon i gud, wan long wan saet. Tekem taem blong tromoe wan sol wan wan, o pasim sipos yu no wantem.
Taem tromoe i kasem wan ring, man we i tromoe i tikem wan bokis long kolam blong hem, long ros blong dat ring.
Lukluk long ol tik tugeta taem yu stop, sipos yu wantem. Nogat wan we i nidim blong somap eni samting.
Stopem taem eniwan i redi blong stopem.
seatedToss.safetyLine: Usum nomoa wan beg we kava i sewn finis, o wan sok we yu rolem. Stap sidaon, no evu tromoe i go long fes, mo holem wan bigfala man i stap klosap. Ol smol pat i save mekem man i sok.
flags: No blong ol pikinini we oli smol moa long 3 yia: ol smol pat
Kipim i fara long ol maot
safety: Jusum wan bin beg we kava i sewn finis, o rolem wan klin sok. Lukluk gud long hem fastaem long ol hol o ol sewn we i lus, blong no eni fulumap i kam aot.
Bin, raes mo ol narafala smol fulumap i save mekem man i sok. Kipim tufala i fara long ol yangwan pikinini mo long eni man we i putum ol samting long maot.
Stap klosap long hand blong yu mo lukaotem gud sipos eni samting i ken putum long maot.
Stap sidaon. Tromoe i gud mo i daon, long target long tebol, no evu long fes.
seatedToss.previewLabel: Sit we i printem: wan target we garem tri ring we oli nem Klosap, Namel mo Faraot, from aotsaed i go insaed, mo wan tali we garem wan kolam blong wan wan man mo wan ros blong ol bokis we oli no gat eni samting long hem blong wan wan ring.

conversationCards.groupSit: Sitdaon long wan saed we evriwan i save lukim pija. Man we i holem kad, o divaes we i soem bigfala pija, i ridim prompt long vois fastaem.
conversationCards.groupPass: Then pasem kad i go long nekis man. Evri man i talem wan wod o wan sentens long pija, then pasem i go.
conversationCards.groupNoSpeech: Pasem kad i oltaem orait. Wan man i save pas no talem enisamting, mo nomoa man i no gat fasin blong askem wae.
conversationCards.groupEnd: Raon i finis taem kad i bin go raon long saket, o taem grup i fed finis. Nogat wan i winim. Yu save stop taem evri wan i wantem.
